participant_1.name: David
participant_1.personality: Reflective and creative, often introspective. Enjoys music and has a strong sense of responsibility as a single dad.
participant_1.background: My ex cheated and left me for a lawyer. I'm a recording engineer and own my own studio. I prefer being inside. I am a 46-year-old single dad with kids. I live in California, but the recording artist market was dead last year.

participant_2.name: Sarah
participant_2.personality: Friendly and laid-back, enjoys simple pleasures in life like good food and relaxation. Open to meeting new people and sharing experiences.
participant_2.background: I like to eat hamburgers and french fries. I don't drink soda. I live in a house. I like to take walks. I am a single mom of two and I love to cook.
